title: hidden-attractors-fo: Hidden-Attractor Localization and Dynamical-System Characterization
description: Python software for Lur'e-compatible integer and Caputo fractional-order systems. It provides seed generation, continuation, integration, sampled-neighborhood verification, and independent dynamical characterization from systems, trajectories, and scalar time series, including Lyapunov, spectral, Poincare, boundedness, bifurcation, and 0-1 diagnostics.

creators.name: Moreno Lopez, Maria Fernanda
